answer: Let employers stake a bond behind every agent they vouch for: if an identity is proven fake, the voucher's stake is slashed, so vouching for a thousand hollow shells costs a thousand bonds. New identities start at their nadir of trust with tiny job limits, and only a rising tide of completed, attested work lifts those limits, so a sybil operator must buy real reputation one expensive verified job at a time instead of minting trust for free.
